correctness.rationale: The killed generator K=L-diag(kappa) has kappa(A)=sum_{i<j in A}(q_ij+q_ji). For every component of labeled exclusion, the projection onto occupied k-subsets is onto; Doob h-transform coincidence from one state forces h constant along every reachable edge, thus constant kappa. A fixed survival time state-independent uses Perron-Frobenius to force the same. Constant killing gives e^(tK)=e^(-lambda t)e^(tL), including independent exponential killing. When k=n-1, kappa(V\{v})=W-d_v, so weighted degrees must coincide; for 2<=k<=n-2 subset-exchange equations force all symmetrized pair rates equal and connectivity forces a complete graph. Independent exact symmetric pair-sum experiments checked 1400 weighted configurations. Assumptions include finite connected simple graph, both edge directions positive, 2<=k<=n-1.
